super_account.description: Super account configuration. Set to null to skip creating the super account. The security account group and the audit account group must be provided together - either both or neither.
super_account.type:
object({
    admin_account_name           = string
    admin_account_password       = string
    admin_account_description    = optional(string, "")
    security_account_name        = optional(string)
    security_account_password    = optional(string)
    security_account_description = optional(string, "")
    audit_account_name           = optional(string)
    audit_account_password       = optional(string)
    audit_account_description    = optional(string)
  })

i18n.zh-Hans: 高权限账号配置。设为 null 则跳过高权限账号的创建。安全账号组与审计账号组必须同时提供——要么都配置，要么都不配置。
i18n.en-US: Super account configuration. Set to null to skip creating the super account. The security account group and the audit account group must be provided together - either both or neither.
